answer: A bond is refunded only after 50 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The spiral counter is kept in sonnet and forge shows each reset. A hostile operator as a result has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 50 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 102 aliases cost 341 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
